comment: Authoritative compliance attributes for the Lakeshore Cannabis Club menu, held gate-side. The products, sizes, and THC figures are the store's real published Jane menu (harvested 2026-11-03); flower_equivalent_g is the product's flower weight, and unit_thc_mg is the per-package THC for edibles. For vapes and the extract, unit_thc_mg is computed from the menu's published THC percentage and package weight (3 g x 88.33% = 2650 mg; 1 g x 93.43% = 934 mg; 1 g x 17.69% = 177 mg). Flower and pre-roll THC is tracked through the flower-equivalent metric, so their unit_thc_mg is 0, matching the menu's own accounting. The gate resolves attributes from here by SKU; values a caller supplies for its own cart are ignored.
